dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-body toward the posterior terminal region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey tone with consistent median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density dark pixel clusters manifested as a thin vertical line along the central sagittal axis and a single isolated punctate mark on the right posterior quadrant.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp boundary definition at the anterior and mid-lateral margins, transitioning to a diffuse gradient at the posterior tip.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct linear dark mark along the central dorsal ridge and one small, high-contrast dark circular mark on the right side of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear dark mark along the sagittal axis and a distinct dark point on the right posterior dorsal surface.
